detail.longDescription: **media[1256874]**HighlightsRevenue up ~30% year-on-year to $75 million (FY25: $61 million) on a constant-currency basis*.International business is gaining traction in APAC, Europe, US, Latin America, and the Middle East.Daily transactions rose to 400 million with an annualised total payment volume exceeding US$1 trillion across 500+ enterprises and banks.Juspay remained Adjusted EBITDA positive in FY26 at $4 million, excluding ESOP costs.Juspay's core India payments business continued to scale and was profitable for the year.BENGALURU, India, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Juspay, a global payments technology company, today reported revenue of $75 million for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 (FY26), up 30% at constant current from $61 million in FY25. Revenue has more than tripled from $39 million in FY24, a compound annual growth rate of approximately 40%. Daily transactions on Juspay's platform rose to 400 million during the year, for brands including Agoda, Amazon, Decathlon, Flipkart, Google, HSBC, IKEA, IndiGo, LATAM Airlines, Recurly, super.money, Swiggy, Wego, Zepto, and Zurich Insurance.
